name: Harvest Road
summary: Perth content development + virtual serving + internet access + training company (HarvestRoad Ltd, est. 1996, ASX-listed Sept 1999, renamed Guilford Investments Mar 2008); web-services arm gone c.2003.

events.details: Content development, virtual serving, internet access.

refs.label: deListed Australia: HarvestRoad Limited (ASX:HRD) — listed 7 Sep 1999

events.details: Web-services arm gone; later e-learning software. No archived harvestroad.com.au capture ever shows a retail ISP; the pivot to software was complete by 2000 (enterprise content management by 2001-02), so both c. 2003 figures are ~3 years late; the later Giunti/Guilford corporate survival does not extend ISP death. site already a pure software company; ISP/web-services arm gone.

refs.label: From the earliest viewable capture (also Dec 1998) the site describes a software company (WebNOW!/PropertyLIVE!) - no retail internet access offering.
Aug 2000-Apr 2001: homepage reduced to a bare brand splash with no services at all.
By May 2002 (and through the 2003-04 captures relied on by the current/proposal dates) the site was purely enterprise content-management/e-learning software.

events.details: HarvestRoad Limited renamed Guilford Investments Limited 28 Mar 2008 (per deListed); Sidetrack Collective Pty Ltd (ACN 152 778 964, WA; ABN cancelled 14 Apr 2015) has no documented link to HarvestRoad and is not the ISP's legal entity.
